claims.text: LDA and Gibbs sampling were applied to evaluate ISWC and WWW conference publications from 2013-2017, focusing on discovering relationships between topics and paper features.
Gibbs sampling was used to estimate and infer parameters of LDA, allowing for the analysis of topic trends in the publications.
The study utilized abstracts and titles from the publications to implement LDA and extract topic models, revealing insights into research trends.
